annotation.bound_parties_text: The Act binds road users, drivers, vehicle owners and authorised users (including self-driving delivery robot users), and public bodies such as ministries, the Transport Administration and municipalities.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: This Act extends to foreign road users and vehicles registered abroad, which are located in the territory of Estonia, unless an international agreement provides otherwise.
annotation.dates_quote:
Passed 17.06.2010
RT I 2010, 44,
261
Entry into force 01.07.2011
annotation.robot_provision_quote:
means a partially or fully automated or remotely controlled vehicle which moves on wheels or another chassis that is in contact with the ground
